integrity: A complete proof for every admissible multipartite graph is given. The standalone exhaustive tests are corroboration only and do not imply an infinite theorem. No independent external review has been conducted.
limitations: Numerical classification requires each part size at least three. Counting and full extremizer classification additionally require three parts each of size at least four. Exact ordinary k-coalition results involve a distinct at-least-k invariant; one related primary full text was not available for inspection.
title: Sharp two-fair coalition dichotomy on dense complete multipartite graphs
